scope: All 17 phase manifests and 88 lesson structures; targeted close reading and numerical changes documented in the Markdown report. Not an independent expert review of every claim.

phases.title: Setup & first steps
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can someone else reproduce your first result?
phases.remainingGap: Fresh-machine Windows/Linux/macOS walkthroughs and novice usability sessions remain unverified; accelerator setup needs a separately observed device run.

phases.title: Arrays & pure functions
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can you spot a wrong axis even when the program runs?
phases.remainingGap: Sparse and ragged inputs need additional contract-focused labs; this phase deliberately teaches fixed dense arrays first.

phases.title: JAX transformations
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: What changes when you differentiate, batch or compile a function?
phases.remainingGap: Transformation combinations involving nondifferentiable boundaries require further examples; passing smooth fixtures does not validate arbitrary gradients.

phases.title: State, randomness & control flow
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Have you saved everything needed to determine the next step?
phases.remainingGap: Local deterministic state does not establish concurrent-writer or multi-host recovery; the recovery and operations phases extend these boundaries.

phases.title: Math & optimization
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can you explain an optimizer’s behavior from the objective and data?
phases.remainingGap: Constrained, nonsmooth and large-scale stochastic optimization are not covered comprehensively. Current ranking evidence is limited to declared synthetic objectives.

phases.title: Neural network training
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Did the network learn the task, or exploit an evaluation mistake?
phases.remainingGap: Natural-image dataset ingestion, richer augmentation studies and pretrained vision transfer remain larger follow-up labs; synthetic images do not establish real-photo generalization.

phases.title: Data & checkpoint recovery
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can an interrupted run make exactly the same next update?
phases.remainingGap: Network storage failures, concurrent checkpoint writers and true multi-host recovery still need separate failure-injection qualification.

phases.title: Transformers & language models
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can you prove that a predicted token cannot see its future?
phases.remainingGap: Real-corpus curation, tokenizer tradeoff studies, long-context evaluation and live generative quality need further labs beyond the tiny byte-model harness.

phases.title: Performance diagnosis
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: What measured evidence identifies the bottleneck?
phases.remainingGap: CPU traces do not characterize TPU/GPU communication or memory. Target traces and sustained workload measurements remain required for accelerator claims.

phases.title: Distributed training
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Is the distributed update still optimizing the same objective?
phases.remainingGap: Real network collectives, multi-controller ingestion and host-loss recovery are unqualified. The optional launch instructions are preparation, not execution receipts.

phases.title: Scientific computing
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Are you fitting the physical model or the solver’s error?
phases.remainingGap: Adaptive solvers, event handling, stiff systems, PDEs and domain-specific physical validation remain outside the scalar ODE lab.

phases.title: Probabilistic modeling
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Which uncertainty does your model actually represent?
phases.remainingGap: General hierarchical models and robust modern diagnostic workflows need further examples. The instructional sampler is not a replacement for validated inference libraries.

phases.title: Reinforcement learning
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Is the policy improving under a fixed evaluation protocol?
phases.remainingGap: Continuous actions, value-function estimation and larger benchmark environments need new implementation and evaluation labs; this tabular task is deliberately bounded.

phases.title: Pallas kernels
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Does a custom kernel earn its complexity?
phases.remainingGap: Actual TPU/GPU compilation, race diagnosis and target tuning remain unqualified; CPU interpretation cannot close these gaps.

phases.title: Autodiff & JAX internals
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Which mathematical operation does the transformed program represent?
phases.remainingGap: The tiny interpreter is intentionally incomplete. Production extension APIs, effects and full compiler transformation coverage require further targeted work.

phases.title: Deployment, interoperability & edge AI
phases.finding: Adaptation followed edge deployment, and container packaging followed capacity planning; the phase lacked a diagnostic and staged synthesis.
phases.improvement: Does the exported service preserve the model’s complete contract?
phases.remainingGap: Actual edge-device delegates, thermal/energy budgets, packed low-bit kernels and production serving loads remain unqualified. The revised sequence moves adaptation before export and containerization before service capacity planning.

phases.title: Workload operations
phases.finding: Phase entry lacked a diagnostic, staged synthesis and a changed-condition exit task.
phases.improvement: Can you detect, explain and safely recover a failed model release?
phases.remainingGap: Authenticated review, multi-writer promotion, staged cloud rollout, SLO alerting and live-model abuse evaluation still require separate infrastructure and application-specific labs.
